title: Helios Console — Announcements
description: Announcement feed and behavior settings for Helios Console. Preference domain: com.herojoneslabs.helios.console.announcements — deploy as its own Jamf Pro Application & Custom Settings profile. Visibility of the Announcements module itself is gated by the access domain's roles; the ui domain's showAnnouncements switch can hide it further.

configurationVersion.title: Configuration Version
configurationVersion.description: Schema/profile version stamp (informational — logged, nothing else reads it).

announcementsEnabled.title: Announcements Enabled
announcementsEnabled.description: Master switch for the announcements feature. False hides and empties it.

refreshInterval.title: Refresh Interval (min)
refreshInterval.description: How often to check for announcement updates, in minutes. 0 = manual refresh only.

allowLocalFile.title: Allow Local File Source
allowLocalFile.description: Allow loading announcements from the machine-wide local JSON file. Testing convenience only — keep false in production.

allowUserDismiss.title: Allow User Dismiss
allowUserDismiss.description: Allow users to dismiss dismissible announcements.

showUnreadBadge.title: Show Unread Badge
showUnreadBadge.description: Show the unread-count badge on the sidebar row.

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.description: The list of announcements to display.

id.title: ID
id.description: Unique identifier. Read/dismissed state is tracked per id, so reusing an id resurfaces old state.

type.title: Type
type.description: Category — sets the icon and color. Default: info.

expiresAt.title: Expires At
expiresAt.description: Expiration date, ISO 8601. Absent = never expires.

dismissible.title: Dismissible
dismissible.description: Whether users may dismiss this announcement (also requires allowUserDismiss).

requiredReading.title: Required Reading
requiredReading.description: Mark as required reading — cannot be dismissed until acknowledged.

actionURL.title: Action URL
actionURL.description: URL opened by the action button. Absent = no button.

targetPlatforms.title: Target Platforms
targetPlatforms.description: Limit this announcement to specific platforms. Absent = all platforms.
